description: This bar chart compares the performance scores of two models, Flan-T5-783M (blue bars) and GPT-4 (red bars), across six different datasets, each evaluated under two distinct metrics: EM (Exact Match) and F1. The horizontal axis lists the datasets and their respective evaluation metrics in this order: TriviaQA (EM), HotPotQA (EM), 2Wiki (EM), TriviaQA (F1), HotPotQA (F1), and 2Wiki (F1). The vertical axis represents the performance score, scaled linearly from 25 to 85, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 25, 65, and 85. Each dataset has two adjacent bars, one for each model, with the exact score labeled on top of each bar. For TriviaQA (EM), Flan-T5-783M scored 77.3 and GPT-4 scored 77.1. For HotPotQA (EM), Flan-T5-783M scored 37.0 and GPT-4 scored 31.9. For 2Wiki (EM), Flan-T5-783M scored 44.5 and GPT-4 scored 32.5. For TriviaQA (F1), Flan-T5-783M scored 82.8 and GPT-4 scored 83.8. For HotPotQA (F1), Flan-T5-783M scored 49.7 and GPT-4 scored 43.3. For 2Wiki (F1), Flan-T5-783M scored 53.3 and GPT-4 scored 38.1. The bars are not sorted; they appear in the order listed on the horizontal axis. There are no visual emphasis features such as shading or bolding on the bars themselves.
